No user interface was built into this binary.

The API is unaffected and is serving at /api/v1. This page is the placeholder that lets the Go build succeed without a JavaScript toolchain: //go:embed refuses to compile against a directory that is not there, so one file has to be committed (ADR-0028).

The released container image replaces it with the built application. To do the same locally: pnpm --filter @hubtask/webapp build, then copy apps/webapp/dist into presentation/webui/dist.
